text:
Plate is about 26 cm across, so sushi pieces (about 3-4 cm each) are small.

Items:
- Nigiri tuna with rice: the fish is about 6 cm by 3 cm, around 15 g, over rice of about 25 g.
- Crab (California) rolls: 2 pieces at about 30 g each, so 60 g.
- Cucumber rolls (small hosomaki): 2 pieces at about 18 g each, so 36 g.
- Spicy-looking orange rolls (carrot or sweet potato with cucumber): 2 pieces at about 32 g each, so 64 g.
